# Colecto v0.1.0 — first alpha

Colecto is a fast, keyboard-friendly email client for IMAP/SMTP and JMAP, with a Rust
core, a Svelte interface built from extensions, and a daemon you can host yourself.
This is the first release, so here is everything it can do.

## Mail

- Connect as many IMAP/SMTP and JMAP accounts as you like, side by side.
- New mail arrives within seconds through IMAP IDLE and JMAP push, with polling as a
  fallback.
- Read HTML mail safely: it renders in a script-free sandbox, and remote images wait
  for your permission unless you allow them in Settings → Privacy.
- Reply, reply all and forward, with attachments in both directions.
- Search Inbox and Sent through your provider; drafts and local labels are kept in one
  embedded database.
- Credentials are encrypted and protected by your system keychain or a master
  password.

## Workspace

- Panes split, tab and dock like an editor; the layout follows you between devices.
- Command runner on <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>/<kbd>Cmd</kbd>+<kbd>K</kbd>, <kbd>C</kbd> to
  compose, keyboard-resizable panes.
- In-app and desktop notifications for new mail and send approvals, shown at the top
  centre by default.
- A calm dark interface with your choice of accent colour.

## Extensions

- The whole interface is built from bundled extensions.
- Install third-party `.colectoext` packages that run in a WebAssembly sandbox:
  panels, and overlays that draw above the app. You approve an extension's
  permissions once, when installing it.
- Try the example [Oneko cat](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/raw/v0.1.0/docs/extensions/examples/oneko.colectoext),
  or [make your own](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.1.0/docs/extensions/guide.md).

## Self-hosting and automation

- Run `colecto-daemon` on a server so mail keeps arriving while every app is closed:
  Docker image `ghcr.io/hexvale-labs/colectod:v0.1.0`, systemd units, or any other
  supervisor. See [self-hosting](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.1.0/docs/self-hosting.md).
- Automate mail through scoped API keys and an MCP server; nothing is sent without
  your approval.

## Downloads

- Linux: `.deb`, `.rpm` and `.AppImage`. Arch PKGBUILDs for `colecto`,
  `colecto-bin` and `colecto-git` are in `packaging/aur/`.
- Windows: installer `.exe` and `.msi`.
- Android: `.apk` (lightly tested).
- macOS `.dmg` and iOS `.ipa` are unsigned experiments, not supported platforms.

The builds are not code-signed; see
[installing](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.1.0/docs/install.md).

## Known limits

- Only Inbox and Sent are browsable in the app for now; read/unread, star, archive,
  delete, move and full-history paging are next on the
  [roadmap](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.1.0/docs/roadmap.md).
- Stored mail and drafts are not encrypted at rest.
- One owner per daemon; no multi-user hosting or device sync yet.
- Storage formats may change between alpha versions.
